topic: Week 5 recap: 6 Claude lessons for beginners in 60 seconds
post:
Five weeks of learning Claude. Still no tech background needed. 🎓
Here's everything from week 5, in 60 seconds.

1️⃣ Why answers change
A setting called temperature adds variety. Want consistency? Be specific about the format.

2️⃣ Fix messy file names
Share one folder with Cowork, ask for a date_topic pattern, and check the before-and-after list first.

3️⃣ Spreadsheet to chart
Claude Code writes a tiny program to chart your data. You just read the pop-ups and approve.

4️⃣ The "catch me up" prompt
Turn a long email thread into decisions, open items, what's needed from you, and a draft reply.

5️⃣ Set it once
Account-wide instructions in Settings apply to every chat, so you stop repeating yourself.

6️⃣ Beware hidden instructions
Websites, emails and files can hide orders for your AI. Limit access, use trusted sites, and stop if it feels off.

Why it matters:
Week 5 was about getting reliable results, from consistent answers to safe habits. 🧭

Your challenge this week: write your account-wide instructions. It takes 2 minutes.

Which lesson will you try first? 👇

Follow me: I'm teaching one Claude skill a day, no tech background needed.
